headline: SSI’s 9-mo earnings down 37% to P404M
summary: Philippine luxury retailer SSI Group reported a 36.8% fall in net income to P404.3 million for the first nine months of 2026. Higher operating expenses and inflation offset double-digit revenue growth.
why: SSI Group is a Philippine retailer distributing luxury and specialty brands, so its results indicate consumer demand for premium goods in the country.
